root_cause_analysis: Instagram Graph API media container creation/processing has not completed prior to triggering the publish endpoint (Error Code 9007, Subcode 2207027: Media ID is not available / media not ready).
actionable_instructions: Poll the media container status ID until the status_code returns 'FINISHED' before executing the publish call.
Implement an explicit exponential backoff delay when publishing multi-item carousels to allow Meta servers to process media assets completely.
